projects.title: Bayesian Classification and Dimensionality Reduction
projects.summary: Breast cancer classification with Gaussian Naive Bayes, LDA, and QDA, plus face recognition and dimensionality reduction with PCA, Eigenfaces, and Fisher LDA.

projects.title: COVID-19 Severity Prediction with Imbalanced Ensemble Learning
projects.summary: Compares Hellinger-distance trees, undersampling ensembles, and AdaBoost with SMOTE for imbalanced COVID-19 severity classification.
projects.imageAlt: Chart of train error, test error, and severe-class F1 over AdaBoost rounds.
projects.imageCaption: Saved experiment figure showing error and severe-class F1 across boosting rounds.

projects.title: Digital Image Processing: Edge Detection and Restoration
projects.summary: Coursework implementations and experiments covering edge detection, multi-scale analysis, noise modeling, image restoration, and enhancement.

projects.title: Digital Image Processing Fundamentals
projects.summary: Manual implementations of spatial-domain techniques including interpolation, point operations, histogram equalization, color enhancement, and histogram specification.

projects.title: Evolution Strategy for Logistic Regression
projects.summary: A self-adaptive Evolution Strategy optimizes a binary logistic regression model for heart disease prediction without gradient descent.

projects.title: Fuzzy Time Series Forecasting from Scratch
projects.summary: Builds first- and high-order fuzzy time-series models with multiple membership functions and evaluates forecasts on Mackey-Glass and influenza series.
projects.imageAlt: Line chart comparing true and predicted Mackey-Glass test values.
projects.imageCaption: True and predicted Mackey-Glass values from a saved test prediction plot.

projects.title: Genetic Programming Maze Solver
projects.summary: A tree-based genetic programming agent evolves maze-navigation programs using selection, subtree crossover, mutation, and fitness evaluation.

projects.title: Hough Transform for Digital Image Processing
projects.summary: Implements Hough circle, line, and generalized Hough methods for traffic-light detection, lane detection, and object localization.
projects.imageAlt: Traffic-light photo annotated with detected lamp circles and state labels.
projects.imageCaption: Detected traffic-light circles and predicted lamp states.

projects.title: Mathematical Morphology and PCB Inspection
projects.summary: From-scratch morphological operations for topological analysis and PCB defect detection, including connected-component analysis, skeletonization, and pruning.

projects.title: Molecular GCN and SELFIES Transformer
projects.summary: Pairs a graph convolutional network with a causal SELFIES Transformer, aligning molecular representations for cross-modal retrieval and generation.
projects.imageAlt: Grid of generated molecular structures from the project notebook.
projects.imageCaption: Generated molecular structures shown in the repository notebook.

projects.title: Kernel and Non-Kernel Learning on Real-World Data
projects.summary: A comparison of kernel and non-kernel methods across Airbnb, NYC 311, IBM HR attrition, and online retail datasets with data-quality and scale challenges.
projects.imageAlt: Bar chart of missing-value rates for selected columns in the Airbnb Open Data dataset.
projects.imageCaption: Missing-value analysis from the Airbnb notebook in this project.

projects.title: Reinforcement Learning Game Agents
projects.summary: Snake and Tic-Tac-Toe agents learn linear value functions from gameplay using handcrafted features and least-mean-squares updates.

projects.title: Statistical Pattern Recognition: Regression and Classification
projects.summary: Four coursework assignments implement linear, binary and multiclass logistic, and Ridge regression on real datasets.

projects.title: Elman vs Jordan Networks for Tiny Shakespeare
projects.summary: A comparison of Elman and Jordan recurrent networks on character-level language modeling and text generation with the Tiny Shakespeare dataset.

projects.title: TSK Fuzzy System for Asphalt Property Prediction
projects.summary: A from-scratch Takagi-Sugeno-Kang fuzzy inference system predicts asphalt mixture properties using Fuzzy C-Means, Gaussian membership functions, and first-order rules.
